text.content:
We Sabersworn abjure the Dark Side, and actively work against its teachings or the evil spreads, wherever it may rear its evil head.

The Sabersworn were once born from the original Jedi Council, and we have their same aversion to the Dark Side. We are against corruption in the strictest sense, and while we understand there are moral and ethical disagreements to be had in all walks of life, we know that those can be solved without debasing ourselves, without the taint of the Dark Side. For the Dark Side is known to pull even the most well-meaning Force-users to a place of evil. It takes control of the best of us—unless we guard our hearts and minds against it.

Quest Starter: An up-and-comer amongst us Sabersworn recently fell to the Dark Side, and he may have betrayed us. They were originally going to be banished, but our leaders deemed them too dangerous to be set loose. So, they were imprisoned, but they’ve recently escaped and is loose upon the galaxy? Who was this fallen fellow Sabersworn? What turned them to the Dark Side? How will we find them? What are our orders once we do find them?

We Sabersworn are undecided about whether or not the Dark Side is “viable” or “safe” to use…but some of us have started dabbling in it to get the job done. This may lead to corruption from within the Sabersworn, but at present we are not equipped to stamp out every report of it rising in our ranks.

The Dark Side is a path to many powers and abilities that some would call “unnatural.” But who can say for sure? After all, none of us are true Jedi, and cannot be certain that there is anything innately wrong with it. Perhaps the old Jedi Order was simply too afraid to master the Dark Side? Perhaps it’s possible for us to accomplish what they could not, total access to all aspects of the Force without falling towards evil. So…perhaps we can find a way to use Dark Side powers without falling to the Dark Side? Is that even possible? Can we, Sabersworn, find a way to use the Dark Side so that we do not fall victim to its total corruption and seduction, and refrain from become avatars to the Dark Side’s evil intentions?

Quest Starter: A small “cult” of Dark Side users have emerged amongst the Sabersworn, claiming to have been able to tap into Dark Side powers without having to fall to its corruption completely. They claim to have gotten this knowledge from a myriad of sources—Dathomiri witches, old Sith texts, even a few Jedi such as Master Mace Windu who used a lightsaber form known as Vaapad (Form VII) that requires one to tap into their darker emotions to gain power, and yet still keep those emotions in check. These cultists have created their own sub-group, and given themselves a name. What is their name? Will you join them? Do you find their methods to be “a bridge too far”?

We Sabersworn use both sides of the Force no matter what.

This mode of play assumes that you’ve somehow managed to conduct Dark Side powers, such as tutaminis (Force lightning) and Force choking, and while perhaps being an aggressive character you are not inherently evil. Your character(s) are going to use whatever means necessary to defeat the Empire, even if you are playing in the post-Civil War era and are going after any Inquisitor stragglers who someone like Jorus C’baoth.

Quest Starter: The Dark Side is useful, and while you are not yet corrupted or controlled by whatever power is behind it, you do occasionally feel the tug of the Dark Side…including the one you and other Sabersworn call “The Dark Speaker.” It speaks to you in both male and female voices, in various languages, sends you strange visions that seem like prophecies. What are these visions/prophecies? What do they foretell? Will you get closer to this “Dark Speaker” to try and discover their motives? How will you do that and guarantee you do not fall utterly into the realm of evil?
